oil_pressure.name: Oil Pressure Warning
oil_pressure.action: STOP immediately and check oil level

engine_temperature.name: Engine Overheating
engine_temperature.action: Pull over safely and let engine cool

brake_warning.name: Brake System Warning
brake_warning.action: Check if handbrake is released. If still on, STOP driving

airbag_srs.name: Airbag System Malfunction
airbag_srs.action: Safe to drive but airbags may not deploy

power_steering.name: Power Steering Failure
power_steering.action: Steering will be heavy but drivable

adblue_warning.name: AdBlue / SCR System Warning
adblue_warning.action: Refill AdBlue within 500-1000 km or vehicle will not start

lane_assist.name: Lane Assist Warning
lane_assist.action: Clean windshield camera area, check system settings

blind_spot.name: Blind Spot Monitoring Fault
blind_spot.action: Clean sensors on rear bumper, check system

parking_sensors.name: Parking Sensor Fault
parking_sensors.action: Clean sensors on bumpers, system may work partially

adaptive_cruise.name: Adaptive Cruise Control Fault
adaptive_cruise.action: Clean front radar sensor, check system

pre_collision.name: Pre-Collision System Warning
pre_collision.action: Clean sensors, system may still provide warnings

low_washer_fluid.name: Low Washer Fluid
low_washer_fluid.action: Top up windshield washer fluid reservoir

door_ajar.name: Door Ajar Warning
door_ajar.action: Check all doors and trunk are properly closed

fuel_cap.name: Fuel Cap Warning
fuel_cap.action: Tighten fuel cap, may need replacement

transmission.name: Transmission Warning
transmission.action: Reduce load, drive carefully to service, avoid towing

awd_4wd.name: AWD/4WD System Warning
awd_4wd.action: Vehicle may operate in 2WD mode, drive carefully

hill_descent.name: Hill Descent Control Fault
hill_descent.action: Use manual braking on steep descents

hybrid_system.name: Hybrid System Warning
hybrid_system.action: Vehicle may operate in ICE-only mode, drive to service

ev_battery.name: EV Battery Warning
ev_battery.action: Reduce power usage, charge immediately if possible

coolant_level.name: Low Coolant Level
coolant_level.action: Check coolant level when engine cool, top up if needed

exhaust_filter.name: Exhaust Filter / GPF Warning
exhaust_filter.action: Drive at higher RPM for 15-20 minutes to regenerate

stability_control.name: Stability Control Warning
stability_control.action: Normal driving possible but reduced safety in emergency
